properties.WarningTitle: AVOID SMOKE - Yeppoon (near Rockhampton) - fire as at 1:56pm Saturday, 22 August 2026
properties.CallToAction: Avoid Smoke
properties.WarningText:
Thick smoke is affecting Yeppoon, Taroomball, Taranganba and surrounding areas. This is from a fire burning near Tanby Road and Taranganba Street, Taroomball.

Fire crews are currently on scene. Protect yourself from the impacts of smoke.

What you should do:

- If the smoke is thick where you are, stay inside and close windows and doors.

- If you need medication to help you breathe keep it close.

- If you are worried about your health call your doctor or 13 HEALTH (13 432 584). If it is an emergency, call Triple Zero (000) now.

- If you are affected by the smoke you may need to leave the area.

- Check for warning updates often.

- Do not fly drones around the fire as they affect firefighting.

Impacts:

- No properties are at risk.

- Smoke could make it hard for some people to breathe and can cause health issues.

- Some roads may be closed or impacted by smoke. It could be hard to see. You may need to drive a different way.

More information:

- For all fire warnings, visit the Qld Fire website.

- Follow Queensland Fire Department on Facebook.

- For road closures, visit the QLD Traffic website or call 13 19 40.

- For live air quality data visit the Department of Environment and Science website.

- For local information visit your Council’s Local Disaster Dashboard.

- If you need translation, call TIS National on 131 450.

- Learn how to get ready for a bushfire on the Qld Fire website - Prepare - Bushfire.

Updates will be issued if the situation changes.

This warning is from the Queensland Fire Department.

properties.WarningTitle: AVOID SMOKE - Jacobs Well (near Ormeau) - fire as at 6:46pm Saturday, 22 August 2026
properties.CallToAction: Avoid Smoke

- If the smoke is thick where you are, stay inside and close windows and doors.

- If you need medication to help you breathe keep it close. Smoke can make it hard to breathe.

- Stay away from the area if you do not need to be there.

- Check for warning updates often and listen to your local radio station.

- Do not fly drones around the incident as they affect firefighting.

- If you are in danger, call Triple Zero (000) now.

Impacts:

- Some roads may be closed or impacted by smoke. You may need to drive a different way.

- Smoke can make it hard to see when driving.

What firefighters are doing:

- Firefighters are working to control the incident.

More information:

- Follow Queensland Fire Department on Facebook.

- If you are worried about your health call your doctor or 13 HEALTH (13 432 584).

Updates will be issued if the situation changes.
